recognitionRules: Use Calibri with a compact decision-oriented title.

Give the requested decision a distinct closing block rather than burying it in the evidence table.

logoDirection: Use THE INVITATION BRIEF in Calibri with a small study code. No envelope or invitation-card symbol.
invariants: Use Calibri with a compact decision-oriented title.

adaptations: A new brief changes the product question and evidence together.
Keep it distinct from the Decision Record family unless an explicit shared system is chosen.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
